summary: Lowell identifies its existing data-center property as Light Industrial. Its planning department states that a lawfully pre-existing nonconforming use may continue until a change of use or abandonment for two years. This site guidance does not grant new data centers district-wide permission, and the city describes its permanent zoning rewrite as pending.
locator: Data Centers, Q&A re existing Markley use, MGL Ch 40A §6; district of existing facility
authority: City of Lowell Department of Planning and Development
